ThingDef.label: point-defense laser turret
ThingDef.description: An autonomous laser turret dedicated to intercepting incoming missiles and other interceptable craft. It needs no crew or ammunition, but each shot draws stored energy.

ThingDef.label: small heavy turret
ThingDef.description: A crewed heavy cannon. Load steel-made propellant and projectile heads separately. Adjust charge and head mass independently; each shot heats the cannon according to its propellant charge and firing resumes once it has cooled completely. One slot accepts fire control or an auxiliary magazine.

ThingDef.label: small rapid turret
ThingDef.description: A crewed rapid cannon using one propellant and one head per shot. Adjust firing rate to trade concentrated bursts for heat buildup. Overheating locks firing until completely cool. One attachment slot.

ThingDef.label: small laser turret
ThingDef.description: A crewed laser turret needing no physical ammunition. Higher power increases damage and stored-energy cost per pulse. A beam affects only its first structure and may be refracted by electromagnetic shields. One slot accepts fire control or a rechargeable capacitor.

ThingDef.label: medium heavy turret
ThingDef.description: A crewed heavy cannon with higher charge and head-mass limits and faster cooling. Load propellant and heads separately. Heat depends on charge; firing resumes once it has cooled completely. Two slots accept fire control or auxiliary magazines.

ThingDef.label: medium rapid turret
ThingDef.description: A crewed rapid cannon with greater heat capacity and cooling. Each shot uses four propellant units and two projectile heads; its firing rate is adjustable. Overheating locks firing until completely cool. Two attachment slots.

ThingDef.label: medium laser turret
ThingDef.description: A crewed medium laser turret. Adjustable power raises damage and stored-energy cost without adding single-pulse penetration. Electromagnetic shields can refract the beam. Two slots accept fire control or rechargeable capacitors.

ThingDef.label: missile launcher
ThingDef.description: An airtight cold-launch missile rack with one internal ready missile. Haulers load it before filling attached magazines; the ready missile can be ejected manually.

ThingDef.label: missile magazine wall
ThingDef.description: An airtight missile magazine with 20 internal slots shared by all missile types. Haulers insert missiles; linked powered launchers load from its inventory. Set per-type limits or eject stored missiles with its commands.

ThingDef.label: railgun loading unit
ThingDef.description: A fixed-axis siege railgun with built-in fire control. Each shot requires manufactured projectile heads and a 675 Wd base pulse. Powered accelerators increase speed, penetration and shield-breaking power. Oblique impacts on kinetic line shields can destabilize or shatter the penetrator. Each of the two slots accepts a uranium magazine, capacitor or rapid reset module. A charged capacitor can supply one base pulse. The base shot interval is 35 seconds, halved by each enabled rapid reset module.

ThingDef.label: rail accelerator
ThingDef.description: An accelerator for a railgun. Each paid pulse costs 675 Wd and adds a fixed amount of kinetic energy, improving penetration. Unfunded segments are skipped. Each side accepts a capacitor or an energy recovery module. Two full capacitors supply two local pulses; two recovery modules halve this segment's grid cost.

ThingDef.Name: DeltaV_AutoAimPluginBase
ThingDef.label: auto-aim plugin I
ThingDef.description: A slot-mounted targeting computer equivalent to Shooting 10.

ThingDef.label: auto-aim plugin II
ThingDef.description: An advanced targeting computer equivalent to Shooting 16.

ThingDef.label: uranium auxiliary magazine
ThingDef.description: A priority-1 magazine loaded with manufactured uranium heads. Supplies the host gun's full requested head count; propellant remains in the host. Uranium heads are heavier and penetrate better.

ThingDef.label: laser capacitor
ThingDef.description: Stores 600 Wd for a laser turret at 100% charging efficiency. Starts empty and connected: surplus grid power charges it, and grid demand can draw from it. It cannot short circuit, and grid short circuits cannot drain it. Disconnect to reserve its energy for its attached weapon; grid charging also stops. Supplies a whole shot when possible, otherwise the weapon draws from grid batteries. Self-discharges at 5 W.

ThingDef.label: railgun capacitor
ThingDef.description: Stores 675 Wd for a railgun loading unit or accelerator, enough for one local pulse, at 100% charging efficiency. Starts empty and connected: surplus grid power charges it, and grid demand can draw from it. It cannot short circuit, and grid short circuits cannot drain it. Disconnect to reserve its energy for its host; grid charging also stops. Insufficient local charge makes the host draw the whole pulse from grid batteries. Self-discharges at 5 W.

ThingDef.label: railgun slug
ThingDef.description: A high-velocity penetrator. Shields and destroyed structures consume its remaining impact budget; empty compartments do not. A kinetic shield breaks it into fragments without deep penetration.
